name: file_chown
title: Change owner or group of a file

origin.description: Change owner or group of a file

arguments.name: path
arguments.text: A character vector of one or more paths.

arguments.name: user_id
arguments.text:
The user id of the new owner, specified as a numeric ID or
name. The R process must be privileged to change this.

arguments.name: group_id
arguments.text:
The group id of the new owner, specified as a numeric ID or
name.

origin.details: Change owner or group of a file
origin.example:
path <- file.path(tempdir(), "fs-chown-example")
file_create(path)
file_chown(path, user_id = Sys.info()[["user"]])
print(file_info(path)$user)
